name: swiftDeclarations

versions.rationale: Counts every declaration of each name, stored properties, enum cases and private ones included. On Alamofire a rename of CachedResponseHandler.cache also renamed ResponseCacher.cache and an enum case, which no editor rename would do; renames now need the name declared once.

docs:
How many times each name is declared in `texts`, units or not: stored properties, enum cases and private
declarations too. A rename by text is only an editor's rename when the name is declared once.
